brief_rationale: The trajectory contains no serious responsibility-chain error. RC1 has a minor error because the doctor briefly acknowledged patient-read data risks (event lite_evt_00046) but never asked the patient to read actual item names, dates, status, values, reference ranges, or report conclusions for the displayed entries; only patient-generated partial transcription appeared later without explicit doctor-driven request. This caps the grade at 2. Two high-order points (HO2 and HO3) were completed with meaningful impact, but the in-chain minor error prevents grades 3–5.
